about: Every website found by the town-by-town Web IQ search (catalog/search-log-towns.json) and how it was sorted, so it is not checked again. Websites marked 'catalog' have a full entry in catalog/sources.json. Made by the October 2026 source search; see docs/source-catalog.md.

decisions.platform: big platform, ticket seller, national directory, map, review or listing site
decisions.out-of-area: search result titles point outside Nassau and Suffolk
decisions.low-signal: no sign of an event list in titles or addresses
decisions.blocked: blocks our bot (robots.txt, 403/429 or a bot check)
decisions.few-dates: one or two upcoming dates only (a single event page)
decisions.no-dates: no upcoming dates on the page
decisions.stale: newest date more than a year old
decisions.not-long-island: upcoming dates, but no Long Island address or place, or no dance or live-music words
